examples.title: Pull just the Factur-X XML payload

description: Read-only extraction of embedded files (PDF/A-3, Factur-X, ZUGFeRD): name, mimeType, AFRelationship, description, sizeBytes and (by default) the payload as dataBase64. `filename` selects one file; `includeData:false` probes metadata only. Encrypted sources: pass `password`. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary'.

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['attachments.name']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

filename.description: Optional exact attachment name to extract. When omitted, every embedded file is returned.

includeData.description: When true (default) each attachment carries its decoded payload as dataBase64. Set false for a metadata-only probe (names, sizes, relationships) with no payload bytes.

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes to read embedded files from.

verbosity.description: Response verbosity. 'full' (default) returns the attachments[] array; 'summary' returns a token-frugal { attachmentCount } and drops the array.

name: extract_attachments

outputSchema.description: Structured attachment-extraction result. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

dataBase64.description: Decoded file bytes, base64-encoded. Present only when includeData is true.

title: Extract embedded files from PDF
